item.title: San Jose residents plagued by mail theft with stolen master keys amid ongoing investigation
item.description: Concerned residents have been reporting issues of mail theft in San Jose, where thieves have been using master keys to steal credit cards, checks and other important mail.

item.title: Foster City declares emergency after cyberattack forces city computer system offline for days
item.description: Following a ransomware attack, Foster City officials say they took most of their computer systems offline as a precaution after discovering suspicious activity. Days later, the issue is still ongoing and public services remain limited.
